Reuben_1: firstborn son of Jacob (Genesis 29:32), son of Leah
Simeon_1: second-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:33), son of Leah
Judah_1: fourth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:35), son of Leah
Dan_1: fifth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:5), son of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid
Naphtali_1: sixth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:7), son of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid
Gad_1: seventh-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:11, Genesis 35:26), son of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid
Asher_1: eighth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:11, Genesis 35:26), son of Zilpah, Leah's handmaid
Issachar_1: ninth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:17), son of Leah
Zebulun_1: tenth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 30:19), son of Leah
Benjamin_1: twelfth-born son of Jacob and Rachel (Genesis 35:18)
Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
Aaron_1: brother of Moses (Exodus 4:14) and Levitical priest (Exodus 28:1)
Nahshon_1: son of Amminadab and brother of Elisheba (Exodus 6:23), head of the tribe of Judah during the census (Numbers 1:7)
Elizur_1: head of the tribe of Reuben during the census (Numbers 1:5)
Shelumiel_1: head of the tribe of Simeon during the census (Numbers 1:6)
Nethanel_1: head of the tribe of Issachar during the census (Numbers 1:8)
Eliab_1: head of the tribe of Zebulun during the census (Numbers 1:9)
Elishama_1: head of the tribe of Ephraim during the census (Numbers 1:10)
Gamaliel_1: head of the tribe of Manasseh during the census (Numbers 1:10)
Abidan_1: head of the tribe of Benjamin during the census (Numbers 1:11)
Ahiezer_1: head of the tribe of Dan during the census (Numbers 1:12)
Pagiel_1: head of the tribe of Asher during the census (Numbers 1:13)
Eliasaph_1: head of the tribe of Gad during the census (Numbers 1:14)
Ahira_1: head of the tribe of Naphtali during the census (Numbers 1:15)
Hobab_1: the son of Reuel, Moses' father-in-law (Numbers 10:29)
